description: This file defines TypeScript type aliases for 'NodeEvent' and 'NodeEventContext', which specify the structure of event data and context objects used within the gateway server module, particularly for handling node events and their associated data.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Function to broadcast an event with payload and optional dropIfSlow flag.

methods.name: nodeSendToSession
methods.description: Function to send an event to a specific session identified by sessionKey.

methods.name: nodeSubscribe
methods.description: Function to subscribe a node to a session.

methods.name: nodeUnsubscribe
methods.description: Function to unsubscribe a node from a session.

methods.name: addChatRun
methods.description: Function to add a ChatRunEntry associated with a session ID.

methods.name: removeChatRun
methods.description: Function to remove a chat run, returning the removed ChatRunEntry or undefined.

methods.name: getHealthCache
methods.description: Function to retrieve current health summary cache.

methods.name: refreshHealthSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronous function to refresh the health snapshot, optionally probing.

methods.name: loadGatewayModelCatalog
methods.description: Asynchronous function to load ModelCatalog entries for the gateway.

methods.name: logGateway.warn
methods.description: Logging function to issue warning messages.
